abilities.name: Creep Tumor
abilities.text:
Lay a Creep Tumor that generates Creep. While on Creep, Zagara moves 20% faster and her summons move 30% faster. Tumors lose Health over 250 seconds and reveal the surrounding area while active.

Stores up to 3 charges.

abilities.name: Baneling Barrage
abilities.text:
Launch 2 Banelings that deal 80 damage to enemies they hit.

Stores up to 2 charges.

abilities.name: Hunter Killer
abilities.text: Summon a Hydralisk to attack a single target, dealing 71 damage per second. The Hydralisk loses Health over 10 seconds, and has 500 Health.

abilities.name: Infested Drop
abilities.text:
Bombard target area with a Zerg Drop Pod for 140 damage.

The pod spawns 2 Roachlings that deal 30 damage per second and lose Health over 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Nydus Network
abilities.text:
Summon a Nydus Worm on Creep anywhere that Zagara has vision. Zagara can enter a Nydus Worm and travel to any other Nydus Worm by right-clicking near it. While inside a Nydus Worm, Zagara regenerates 10% Health and Mana per second.

Stores up to 2 charges. Maximum of 4 Nydus Worms at a time.

Passive: Creep spreads 15% farther.
Passive: While on Creep, each Basic Attack reduces all of Zagara's cooldowns by 0.4 seconds.

abilities.name: Devouring Maw
abilities.text:
Summon a Devouring Maw that devours enemies for 4 seconds. Devoured enemies cannot fight and take 94 damage per second.

Usable on Unstoppable enemies.

1.name: Volatile Acid
1.text: Banelings can travel 50% further before exploding.

1.name: Corpse Feeders
1.text: Reduces the cooldown of Infested Drop by 3 seconds and Roachlings have 30% more Health.

1.name: Infest
1.text:
Nearby Ranged Minions deal an additional 100% damage. Can be toggled on or off.

Repeatable Quest: Every 1000 Siege damage dealt increases this bonus by 1%.

4.name: Envenomed Spines
4.text: Activate to have Zagara's next Basic Attack apply 230 damage over 5 seconds.

4.name: Medusa Blades
4.text: Basic Attacks deal 33% damage to three nearby targets.

4.name: Serrated Spines
4.text: Quest: Each Basic Attack against a Hero increases Zagara's Attack Damage by 0.2%.

7.name: Baneling Massacre
7.text: Gain 2 additional charges of Banelings Barrage, but increase its cooldown by 2 seconds.

7.name: Viscous Acid
7.text: Banelings Slow enemies by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

7.name: Bile Drop
7.text:
Quest: Passively increases the radius of Infested Drop by 20%.

Reward: After hitting 12 Heroes with Infested Drop, it spawns an additional Roachling.

10.name: Devouring Maw
10.text:
Summon a Devouring Maw that devours enemies for 4 seconds. Devoured enemies cannot fight and take 94 damage per second.

Usable on Unstoppable enemies.

10.name: Nydus Network
10.text:
Summon a Nydus Worm on Creep anywhere that Zagara has vision. Zagara can enter a Nydus Worm and travel to any other Nydus Worm by right-clicking near it. While inside a Nydus Worm, Zagara regenerates 10% Health and Mana per second.

Stores up to 2 charges. Maximum of 4 Nydus Worms at a time.

Passive: Creep spreads 15% farther.
Passive: While on Creep, each Basic Attack reduces all of Zagara's cooldowns by 0.4 seconds.

13.name: Hydralisk Transfusion
13.text: Zagara is healed for 60% of the damage dealt by Hunter Killers' Basic Attacks to Heroes.

13.name: Protective Coating
13.text: While on Creep, Zagara gains 20 Armor, taking 20% less damage.

13.name: Spell Shield
13.text:
Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

16.name: Corrosive Saliva
16.text: When attacking Heroes, Hunter Killers and Roachlings deal additional damage equal to 1.5% of their maximum Health.

16.name: Mutalisk
16.text: Reduce the cooldown of Hunter Killer by 4 seconds. Hunter Killer now spawns a Mutalisk. Mutalisks have a bounce attack, lose Health over 42 seconds, and have 450 Health.

16.name: Jagged Barbs
16.text: While on Creep, Zagara gains 50% more Basic Attack damage and her attack range is increased by 1.1.

20.name: Tyrant Maw
20.text: Devouring Maw deals 50% more damage. Takedowns reduce its cooldown by 25 seconds.

20.name: Endless Creep
20.text: Increase Creep Tumor's cast range from 2.5 to 50. Creep Tumors now last 600 seconds. While on Creep, Zagara gains an additional 10% Movement Speed.

20.name: Broodmother
20.text:
Every 3rd Basic Attack also launches a Baneling towards the target.

Passive: Gain 20% bonus Attack Speed.

20.name: Pack Instinct
20.text: Zagara and her summons deal 20% more damage to enemies attacked by a Hunter Killer in the last 2 seconds.
